title: Gudun Ketare Teku Mai Tashi
intro: Hoton yana tsaye a kan wani jirgin ruwa mai cike da kaya yayin da raƙuman ruwa ke ƙaruwa kuma ma'aikatan jirgin suna jefa ƙuri'a don rage nauyin. Wani mutum ɗaya ya taka gaba, yana karɓar ƙaddara da ta yi kama da ƙarshe, sai kawai zurfin ya zama wurin addu'a da dawowa. A bayan ƙarya, al'umma ta yi gargaɗi game da hukunci mai zuwa, a gaba akwai rahamar da ba a zata ba.
clues: An aiko ni a matsayin manzo zuwa ga mutane sama da dubu ɗari.
Na bar mutanena cikin fushi kafin na sami izinin tafiya.
Na shiga jirgin ruwa mai lodi kuma ma'aikatan jirgin suka yi kuri'a don tantance wanda za a jefa a cikin jirgin.
An jefa ni cikin teku aka haɗiye ni da babban kifi yayin da nake da laifi.
Na yi wa Allah tasbihi a cikin duhu, ina shelar babu abin bautawa sai Shi, kuma na kasance cikin azzalumai.
An jefa ni a bakin teku, ina rashin lafiya, sai Allah ya sa wata shukar 'ya'yan itace ta tsiro a kaina, sai mutanena suka yi imani aka kuma ba su jin daɗi na ɗan lokaci.

trial.label: Wace Jaraba Na Fuskanta?
options: An jefa shi cikin wuta da aka sanyaya kuma aka yi masa aminci
Babban kifi ya haɗiye shi bayan ya gudu
'Yan'uwa masu kishi sun jefa su cikin rijiya mai zurfi
Ya kamu da rashin lafiya na dogon lokaci da kuma rashin lafiya
An umarce shi da ya yi hadaya da ɗa ƙaunatacce
trial.answer: Babban kifi ya haɗiye shi bayan ya gudu
